evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: an unrehearsed rollback set against a rollback one does not actually have — matched clause structure crystallizes the rule into opposed terms.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the rule here crystallized into matched opposed clauses that make the contrast itself the argument?
